meta.name: earn-trust
meta.description: Plan how to earn customer trust and appropriate access. Use when credibility, permissions or AI policy constrain the engagement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理清赢得客户信任并取得合适权限的推进步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果信任、权限或 AI 使用政策卡住了与客户的合作
copy.tagline_en: Map out how to win customer trust and get the right access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if trust, permissions or AI policy are blocking a client engagement

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在动手调查或行动前会先读任务上下文契约和方法文档，再帮你规划如何赢得客户信任、争取合适的访问权限。遇到缺能力或没跑过的检查，它会如实说明，不假装已具备。
howto.when: 当可信度、权限或 AI 政策限制这次合作时接管。若由 @fde 调用，会复用其当前脱敏数据包和已划定范围，不重开设置、发现或已答过的问题。

say.text: 帮我规划怎么赢得这个客户的信任
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约和方法文档

say.text: 我们的 AI 政策限制了这次合作，该怎么推进
say.note: 按方法给出信任与权限规划

say.text: 现在权限不够，规划怎么拿到合适的访问权限
say.note: 区分实现、验证、部署与验收

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude reads the task context contract and the method before investigating or acting, then helps you plan how to earn customer trust and appropriate access. It reports missing capabilities or unrun checks honestly instead of pretending they exist.
howto.when_en: Takes over when credibility, permissions or AI policy constrain the engagement. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope, without restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Plan how to earn this customer's trust
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract and method first

say_en.text: Our AI policy limits this engagement; how do we proceed
say_en.note: Gives a trust and access plan per the method

say_en.text: We lack permissions; plan how to get appropriate access
